content.enriched_brief: Make a period rebirth-revenge palace-intrigue animated short drama. The female lead is the former empress, a woman depicted wearing an ornate gold, pearl, and jade crown and a dark blue embroidered robe, standing in a softly lit traditional building. She was forced to drink poisoned wine, and after being reborn back to the day of the imperial selection, this time she will personally send every soul who once owed her a life into the underworld.
